description: This file contains C# source code defining a set of test classes for verifying SQL-based subscription observers in Orleans streaming, including specific implementations for SQL Server, MySQL, and PostgreSQL, as well as a base class with setup and configuration logic for these tests.

classes.name: SqlServerAdoNetSubscriptionObserverWithImplicitSubscribingTests
classes.description: Test class for SQL Server ADO.NET subscription observer with implicit subscribing.

classes.name: MySqlAdoNetSubscriptionObserverWithImplicitSubscribingTests
classes.description: Test class for MySQL ADO.NET subscription observer with implicit subscribing, including pool clearing.

classes.name: PostgreSqlAdoNetSubscriptionObserverWithImplicitSubscribingTests
classes.description: Test class for PostgreSQL ADO.NET subscription observer with implicit subscribing.

classes.name: AdoNetSubscriptionObserverWithImplicitSubscribingTests
classes.description: Abstract base class providing setup, configuration, and lifecycle management for ADO.NET streaming subscription tests, with configurations for different relational databases.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: Inner class within the base test class that manages test setup, including database testing environment initialization and silo/client configuration.

classes.name: TestClusterConfigurator
classes.description: Inner class responsible for configuring the Orleans silo and client to use ADO.NET streams with explicit options for the specific relational database.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Sets up the test fixture environment asynchronously, including database setup and precondition checks.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes resources allocated by the fixture.
